english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something seems or appears to be a certain way.

exampleSentences.english: I seem to think they aren't feeling well.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6

english.note: Use 好似 when “look” means seem or appear to be something.

exampleSentences.english: You look like you're not feeling well today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6 wo3
